nom: I Dew Care Space Kitten Exfoliating Charcoal Peel-Off Mask

avis.texte: It's really pretty and all but it does not work. I tried it for the 3 times but it doesn't make a change, it does not take any blackheads or any whiteheads.

Just like the instructions say, it really does take 30-35min to completely dry so youre able to peel it off. Negative is that it was too gentle and too weak to really pull out all the sebaceous filaments I had. It maybe got 50% of them :-/ No strong smell. Very pretty and glittery. Of course applying with your fingers means it's going to get a little messy! No big deal, just wash your hands.

This mask was gifted by idewcare to me. I really love it. I've been using it a lot and it makes my skin so much brighter and gets rid of impurities. It gets rid of whiteheads as well. I would definitely recommend this.
This is a very good mask that feels like its actually doing something. (I dew care has good masks im referencing other brands) over all ber good

This is so satisfying to pull off, but what I love is that it really gets into my pores and pulls out The buildup that is in there that forms overtime my skin did not get irritated, but what I did not like was the smell it was offputting for me, but thankfully did not irritate my skin gifted. By idewcare

This product was gifted by I Dew Care for free in exchange for my honest opinion. This mask is a lot of fun to use! I would definitely recommend getting a spatula to apply it with in order to get an even layer. I like the blue sparkles in this mask and it looks cute and feels good on my skin. It does have a slightly strong perfume to it. I found that this mask peeled off easily without hurting my skin. Overall, I felt like it was a fun addition to my self-care routine.

I received this mask complimentary from idewcare and I have been loving using it. I apply it in a thick layer on my t-zone. After 20 min you can feel it getting tight and dry. Then when you are ready to remove it just peels off so easily. My favorite part is watching all the gunk pull out of my skin. I love that the formula is black so you can really see everything it gets out. I love the deep cleansing feeling in my pores.

I am such a fan of a peel-able mask! This gave me great joy to use and met all of my needs! My face benefitted by this and felt so smooth and clean afterwards. I actually really liked the black charcoal and all it has to offer. 100% would recommend! Gifted by idewcare :)

I recently tried the I Dew Care Exfoliating Charcoal Mask and was genuinely impressed with its performance. First off, the packaging is adorable, with a fun and colorful design that stands out. The mask has a smooth, creamy texture and applies easily to the skin without being too thick or messy. Upon applying, I noticed a slight cooling sensation that felt refreshing, which I appreciated. The charcoal worked its magic by drawing out impurities and dirt from my pores. The exfoliating bits in the mask provided a gentle scrub without being too harsh or abrasive, making it perfect for sensitive skin like mine. Gifted by idewcare

Really enjoyed this peel-off mask! It left my skin feeling smooth and refreshed, and removed a lot of impurities. A bit tricky to peel in some spots, but overall a great product. Definitely worth trying! 4/5. Gifted by idewcare!

I have been using this product every few days after being gifted by I Dew care. I have been following the recommended method and I really love the product. It's designed to target the T-zone and is infused with sapphire powder to brighten, charcoal and volcanic ash to absorb sebum and impurities, and moringa seed oil to purify and protect against environmental stressors. I like its exfoliating properties and the way it helps to brighten the skin. The mask is vegan, made with clean ingredients, and comes in sustainable packaging, which is a significant plus for eco-conscious consumers. On top of those reasons, it is really fun and relaxing to use. After a long day, this has been my self care. I put a headband on and some music and get in the bathtub or I read a book until it's suggested time to wash off. Which is a breeze. My skin does look so much healthier already and feels so soft and my texture is better. I love the product for the benefits but also I can enjoy and have my me time. I already ordered one for a niece and her friend and some headbands for a birthday party next month and I know they will have a blast. I definitely recommend trying out. It isn't gimmicky it actually is a great product.

I have been using this product every few days after being gifted by I Dew care. I have been following the recommended method and I really love the product. It's designed to target the T-zone and is infused with sapphire powder to brighten, charcoal and volcanic ash to absorb sebum and impurities, and moringa seed oil to purify and protect against environmental stressors. I like its exfoliating properties and the way it helps to brighten the skin. The mask is vegan, made with clean ingredients, and comes in sustainable packaging, which is a significant plus for eco-conscious consumers. On top of those reasons, it is really fun and relaxing to use. After a long day, this has been my self care. I put a headband on and some music and get in the bathtub or I read a book until it's suggested time to wash off. Which is a breeze. My skin does look so much healthier already and feels so soft and my texture is better. I love the product for the benefits but also I can enjoy and have my me time. I already ordered one for a niece and her friend and some headbands for a birthday party next month and I know they will have a blast. I definitely recommend trying out. It isn't gimmicky it actually is a great product.

I love that it is exfoliating so it's like multiple treatments in one! I apply it and then exfoliate it everywhere I need the product and then let it sit until dry. After it dries it's super fun to peel it and it comes off easily all in one peel which I like!

avis.titre: Cool concept, but not my favorite
avis.texte: I received this product complimentary from idewcare in exchange for my honest review. I love the concept of this product and did feel like it did it's job of making my pores smaller, detoxing, pulling out whiteheads & blackheads, and controlling oil. It's a super fun concept as it's black with sparkles in black & silver packaging so it made me feel super luxurious and was oddly satisfying to put on. However it doesn't peel off like it says it's supposed to and I had a really hard time getting it to come off! I also wish it came with some sort of applicator because it got my nails really black and dirty and was so hard to get off of them. I will continue to use this product, but I wouldn't purchase it again! I wanted to like it more but unfortunately am not in love with it!

Tiene brilloooo!! Está muy fun de usar, sería mejor si trajera un aplicador porque se pega en las uñas pero dentro de todo la aplicación es fácil. No es para quitarte los puntos negros, es para exfoliarte. Gifted by idewcare

Product is so easy and simple to use. I loved the application process and the end. I think it's a great product overall. I do wish it would have came with a small brush to apply but other than that it was great. Gifted by idewcare

I love this mask, because it is fun to use. It is satisfying peeling off the mask. I like that this mask gently exfoliates and removes oil. My skin looks brighter after using this peel-off mask. I received this complimentary from I Dew Care.

Gifted by idewcare this charcoal peel-off mask is satisfying and easy to peel off, and it has a super fun sparkle to it. It is great for removing those blackheads and minimizing pores. It leaves your skin feeling super soft.

Great for cleaning the sebun of the pores of the area that with other methods does not go away. I love how soft it is and how fresh it feels on the skin. I have left my skin ready for my skincare without clogged pores.. Gifted by idewcare

I love this mask so much! This mask is great when you apply, I love how it feels on your skin the way it dries fully down and taking it off is kind of fun because you can see the impurities come out This product was gifted by i dew care

I got this product complimentary from Idewcare. Please be aware of your eyes since this product has tons of glitter. No scent which is amazing. It requires a but of force to remove but nothing to crazy. Leaves the skin soft.

I love trying out this exfoliating mask. I love how easy it is to use and how clear it makes my pores. It also is so easy to let it dry and peel off and you can see your skin clear right away. It's perfect for exfoliating my skin. This was gifted by idewcare

Pros: Smells nice, fun color and sparkles. Cons: Does absolutely nothing. Everything this product says it does it actually does not. It is also a pain to wash off your hands and it stained my nail polish a bit. Do yourself a favor spend a bit more for a better quality product.
The mask takes over 40 minutes to dry. Doesnt feel like its takinf anything off my face. BIG BUMMER. I wanted to love this brand.
I was not the least bit impressed with this mask. It did nothing at all for my skin. Waste of my money!

At first the smell wasn't too bad, although it hit me in the face when I opened the jar. After having it on my face for a few minutes, it was beyond overwhelming. Like an intense old-lady floral smell that gave me a headache and was so strong, I could taste it. There's really no need for such an intense fragrance in a skincare product and I will be returning this.

I don't know if I got a bad batch or what, but it cleared out ONE pore. I was shocked. It did absolutely nothing after 35 minutes. The fragrance was overwhelming & glitter is 100% unnecessary, especially in skincare. I'll definitely be returning it.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. This face mask is great! I noticed improved skin texture and clarity after using it. I felt like it reduced the number of clogged pores. This product was gifted by idewcare.

I love this charcoal mask! It smells really nice and it makes my skin so smooth afterwards. It's very easy to apply and it peels off easily. My skin tends to get irritated with beauty products however this didn't irritate my skin at all. This was gifted by idewcare in exchange of my honest opinion.

My face was showing a lot of dark pores around my nose and I saw this product and I knew it was going to help. I got it and it has worked wonders for me. I see no black heads which was one insecurity of mine. Glad I was able to get this product. Gifted by idewcare

I was super excited to try this exfoliating mask. I must start by saying that no I don't suffer from acne or any noticeable blackheads but we all have them right so h expected to see something. I applied to my clean face in the T area. I waited for the product to dry once it dried it was super easy to come off and I got nothing out my face at all. It also did feel a little sticky upon removal making it feel messy, I was gifted by idewcare in exchange for my honest review.

Gifted by idew My t zone looks refreshed. I have bad blackheads & sometimes dry patches. this make it look much better- the refresh i didn't know i needed! I love that it hardens and then peels off. Dries within 15 min!

Gifted by Skeepers. I really enjoyed using this peel off mask! It's very pretty to look at in the package and has lots of glitter in it. It was easy to apply and dried within 30 minutes. It wasn't painful to peel off and I could see all the gunk it pulled out of my skin! Definitely would recommend this mask!

You get a lot of product in this t-zone mask. I like how the brand is cruelty free, vegan, and uses clean ingredients. However, I did notice glitter in the mask for the "Space Kitten" theme but I did wish it didn't contain any. Surprisingly, the mask did not dry out my skin like I expected it to. My skin was smooth. It felt exfoliated and clean. I had no redness! This was complimentary from idewcare.

I love it! It's so easy to apply and to wash off, and while you're wearing it, it doesn't make your face all crusty! It improved the look off my skin and I'm always exited for 'mask day'. Gifted by idewcare. I use it every four days but it still looks untouched because I never needed a lot, it will last for ever! Worth every dollar!
So basically i was using it and i have this big pimple and once i took it off it was gone! No joke!!!

Really enjoy using this! It's simple to apply and doesn't take forever to dry down like some masks. I really like that it doesn't irritate my skin but leaves it clean and my pores look so much better after. My oldest daughter even gave it a try and thought the peel off part was so fun. I did receive this complimentary from idewcare for my honest opinion.

Space Kitten Exfoliating Charcoal Peel-Off Mask is my skincare soulmate. When I need a pick-me-up, this mask has my back, leaving my skin feeling as soft as a kitten's fur. It's a must-have in my beauty routine!Offered by idewcare

This is an amazing mask for acne prone skin. It really helped my skin look clearer after using it without over drying. I love that it peels off, it's fun to do! It made my skin look and feel smooth, clear, and bright. Gifted by idewcare.

I recently discovered this fantastic peel-off mask from idewcare that I can't stop raving about! It's infused with charcoal, sapphire, and a hint of diamond powder - talk about luxury! After using it for just 20 minutes, my skin felt incredibly smooth and rejuvenated. Plus, it's made without any harmful ingredients. Trust me, it's a game-changer for your skincare routine! Gifted by idewcare

OMG this is amazing! My T-Zone looks and feels soo nice and clean and Oil-Free post use. Gors on smooth and Peels off very easily. I have already recommended it to soo many friends and they love it too. Kindly gifted by idewcare

avis.titre: Fun to use but didn't see results on normal-oily
avis.texte: I wanted to love this peel off mask, but my thoughts are simply that it is merely ok. It was fun to use and I like the cool blue glitter specks. The consistency was similar to peel off masks I have used in the past. I did not really notice any benefits from this on my normal to oily skin. My skin looks and feels the same. I will use it again and update if I see different results the next time, but for my skin, this is a pass if I am wanting to use it for more than entertainment purposes. Gifted by idewcare.

I love I Dew Care products and the Space Kitten peel-off mask is fun to use and makes my t-zone feel smoother. The galactic formula is easy to put on and pull off. I did notice it slightly dried my t-zone area. I received this complimentary from IDewCare.

I received this product complimentary from I Dew Care in exchange for my honest review. This is a pretty fun peel off mask. It's black with pretty blue sparkles. You may want to stay away if you have very sensitive skin or a lot of peach fuzz. I feel like it ripped all my facial hair off when I peeled the mask off. It did leave my skin feeling very soft though.

I received this complimentary from i dew care in exchange for my honest review. I have pretty oily skin especially in my t-zone so I had high hope that this would work well for me. Unfortunately, it didn't do anything except dry my skin out. It made it quite irritated. I don't think I'll be using again

It's designed to target the T-zone and is infused with sapphire powder to brighten, charcoal and volcanic ash to absorb sebum and impurities, and moringa seed oil to purify and protect against environmental stressors. I like its exfoliating properties and the way it helps to brighten the skin. The mask is vegan, made with clean ingredients, and comes in sustainable packaging, which is a significant plus for eco-conscious consumers
I bought this and it works so well I'm so happy with the results

It was just ok for me, it's not bad but nothing too special. It dried out half way of using it, so I couldn't finishe the container. I kept the inner lid but it still got hard and couldn't spread on my face anymore.

It's a lot smaller in person, but the container is practically filled. The quality is definitely worth the price, it peels off hairs, blackheads and left my skin feeling soft and luscious. It also has really cute sparkles.

avis.titre: Great mask for an at home spa day!!
avis.texte: I love this mask! Both my husband and I loved using this for our at home spa night! The scent is very pleasant and not over-powering and the texture feels really nice going on the face. I do also use their silicone application brush which is great and gives me a nice even thickness. The peel off part is the best, we literally see the difference it makes and our skin feels super soft and smooth afterwards! Highly recommend!

I love charcoal masks! And this one is a winner. I like how it makes my skin feel super smooth & refreshed after peeling/taking it off. I have combo skin where I have oily on my t-zone & dry everywhere else. Love how gentle, clean and exfoliates my face.

This is absolutely my holy grail. Had been looking for a peel off mask as I have tiny little whiteheads that pop out every once in awhile. Only I can see them on my chin and around my nose. This works and keeps my skin looking fresh, clean and I don't notice them as much. I really enjoyed this peel off mask.

I love a good charcoal mask and this one does not disappoint! This mask feels great going on and feels even better coming off. My T-zone skin felt so clear and nice after I used this mask the first time - definitely now working this into my routine more frequently!

I love using this mask. It's not messy and it's easy to apply. It works great for the T-zone. It has great ingredients and it doesn't irritate my skin. It will make a great gift as well. I recommend it.

I love this mask!! So glittery and fun! A little goes a long way. I love a good peel and this was just that. Highly recommend. The glitter acts like an exfoliate in a way. The only product ive tried from this brand but keen to try more.

When I opened the package, I was in awe of how gorgeous the product is! No wonder it is named space kitten, it is a black mask with gorgeous blue and purple shimmer and looks like the galaxy in a jar. Very easy to apply and smells great. I got some on my hands and it was very easy to wash off. It has a cool refreshing feeling when it's applied and is in the drying process. It was very easy for me to peel off as well and didn't hurt!

this product is very good! It works very well, it smells good, I love the texture and it brings sparkles, it looks spectacular and it cleans my face of blackheads very well, plus the packaging is very nice!

This mask works great! The areas that I used it on felt cleaner and a lot smoother. It didn't really get those deep down blackheads, but it cleared away a lot of the tiny little white heads and a few black heads.

This is the perfect face mask for my T zone! I have used it a couple of times since receiving it and it is doing a great job at clearing up my pores. It peels off perfectly and I would recommend this mask to anyone struggling with congested pores.

Loved this mask! I've been a fan of this brand for a while now and this did not disappoint. I've been using this once a week and my skin feels so refreshed after use. I mainly focus on my nose area and it does the trick

avis.titre: The peel off mask that you NEED
avis.texte: I'm not a big fan of the peel off mask. But can we talk about this mask?! I live that is dark wirh shimmers and make your skin feel soft after one use. It's mot the kind of peel off mask that you just use because everyone is using. It's the kind of mask that you NEED in your skin care routine.

avis.titre: Soft and clear skin on nose
avis.texte: Space Kitten Exfoliating Charcoal Peel-Off Mask gifted by I Dew Care comes in cute packaging. I applied it on my T zone, and peeled it off once it was dry. I noticed the blackhead on my nose to have been addressed. My nose skin felt smooth as well. It contains charcoal and oils and the texture is really smooth.

avis.titre: Would buy if my blackheads weren't deep
avis.texte: Personally, I've never tried a GREAT charcoal mask. I suffer from a lot of blackheads and nothing other than a professional facial mitigates them. Unfortunately, this mask was pretty good, but wasn't great. However, It did pull my surface blackheads which was nice!

I love the super fun packaging and easy application! It can be a little drippy coming out of the jar, but not too bad and very easy to apply. Very easy to remove after totally dry as well. I was gifted by Space Kitten

this is a really cool product! do not use it too much because it will dry out your skin but only apply to your t-zone and peel off and rinse with water and my pores felt so clear and smooth! great mask!

I love this! It did feel a bit stingy at first because all new products to touch my face does so, but after a while, it felt nice and cool! I did masks with my boyfriend and we had so much fun, and it also left our faces nice and smooth.

I received this charcoal mask complimentary from I dew care and I am amazed. It gently exfoliated my skin and made my face so smooth, soft and glowing. My skins impurities has improved. I love that it is non-irritating and made of clean ingredients. I highly recommend.

I was looking for a good face mask and this one is it! This charcoal peel off mask feels so nice on the skin and left my face super smooth after I took it off! You use it in your t-zone and simply peel off once it dries. Love this brand!

I received this complimentary from I Dew Care. The glitter in this mask is so pretty and I was so excited to try it! Unfortunately it smells very strongly of acrylic or oil paint to the point where I feel nauseous from the smell :(

avis.titre: easy to peel off, feels clean
avis.texte: I have oily combination skin, so I love using charcoal mask periodically to clear out my pores. This Space Kitten Exfoliating Charcoal Peel-Off mask is for T zone only (including nose). The texture is very interesting, because, not only charcoal, it also has sapphire and diamond powder, which help brighten and exfoliate skin. It dries completely in about 30 minutes and it is fairly easy to peel off. My skin feels clean and so soft afterward.

I have used this mask twice and I love it!! This is the first time using this brand and I am very impressed with them!! I left the mask on for about 25 minutes and then peeled it off and washed my face with warm water. Right away I did feel like my face was softer and brighter. The price point is also great because it's under $25 a little product goes a long way! I definitely recommend

This charcoal mask is such a great one. I like how it makes my skin feel super smooth after taking it off. It helps keep it clear and I put it on the night before a special day or occasion. It is amazing.

My T zone always been a problem and I had buildups of white heads that always makes me self concerned. I found this T zone mask peel that works really great. With one peel I was able to get the hard to see whiteheads and my skin feel so soft afterward.

I absolutely loved this mask! It is such a gorgeous color with the sapphire shine and was exactly what my t zone has been needing! After using it my skin felt so soft and smooth! Can't recommend enough!

Did ya'll read there's GLITTER in it??!! YES!! So pretty, very gently, cleans and exfoliates very gently. Dries fast, removes all dead skin and leaves a smooth surface. I followed instruction and only used it on T-zone. Complimentary from Space Kitten.

Love this facemask. I'll use it once a week specially after I've done a lot of and make up that week. I feel like it's similar to the strips only that you can control more of where it goes so it's super super great for removing blackheads whiteheads and impurities. Gifted by the brand

Really fun and sparkly mask to apply. It looks so cute in the jar and applies very easily to my T-zone. It is very easy to peel off when dry and it leaves the area feeling smoother and looking cleaner.

Peel off masks are my absolute favorites! And this one both works great and looks super fun because of glitter pieces in it. The container is quite good - it will last you for a long time. I really enjoy it!

This product is so pretty. It has like this pretty glitter look to it! Super cool and fun. However, when I put it in my t-zone I was expecting it to do more. It really didn't "remove" anything like I was expecting it to. My skin did feel really soft after I took the mask off through.

I have been wanting to try a charcoal peel off mask for a long time now and I'm so happy I got to try this one! Application was easy and peeling off and cleaning the remaining was so simple. I love that you can see the progress afterwards!

OMG! This mask is everything! It smells nice, has glitter (so girly, love the vibe), and peels off easily. My skin is sooo clean, no more those painful nose strips for me! I applied it generously on my t-zone and I can tell there's enough product to last for a long time!

I am obsessed with the face mask I have honestly already used it twice and I can feel it working on my face. You put it on and let it sit and then it's easy to peel off if you evenly apply and it smells great and is so cute and sparkly

The space kitten charcoal exfoliating peel off mask is a decent enough product. It does remove grade and some of my blackheads from that area (but not all). It didn't hurt when I had to peel it off. I like the galactic feel when I have it on tho, the shimmery black color is cool

avis.titre: Super soft skin and cute packaging
avis.texte: My skin felt amazing and so soft after! I loved how pretty the mask is too. Also the packing It adorable. It's not too big and it doesn't take up a large amount of space but it has a good amount of Product in it. It dried fairly quick and it peeled off easy. I enjoyed this Mask a lot.

I love how it sparkles and shines. The application is very easy. I left it on for 30 Minutes and it removes quite a few of my blackheads. Way more than I expected. It's very easy to remove not painful at all.

I have combo skin with a slightly oily t zone. I love the glittery black mask, looks like the galaxy and it's so cute and mesmerizing. It's easy to use and does help me control the blackheads in my nose and forehead.
I love the exfoliating peel mask. It does the nice job of absorbing those blackheads and serums. It applies easily and does not hurt at all while peeling. My skin felt soft and smooth afterwards.

This is perfect for those that need to exfoliate your T zone! It glides on your skin very easily, applies very smoothly and detoxifies! The charcoal ingredient is super effect in giving you beautiful, glowing skin!

This product and packaging is so adorable!! I have tried other charcoal masks before but I like this the best because it didn't pull at my skin. The fun little glitters were a nice touch! I would even be glad to get this as a present.

I Dew Care Space Kitten exfoliating Charcoal Peel-Off Mask is super easy to apply and take off. The whole process takes about 35 minutes tops. Apply a generous amount to your clean skin. After 20 to 30 minutes or once dry, peel off. Rinse off any remaining

This product feels amazing on the skin and it gets rid of impurities and clogged pores. My skin feels soo smooth and silky after just one use. I love the brand and their aesthetic. I highly recommend.

This mask works but it is definitely not for sensitive skin so be careful and you'll probably want to test a spot before using it fully. And it really is just for the t zone, I usually use it every other week to not irritate my skin

Space Kitten Exfoliating Charcoal Peel-Off Mask is so adorable for a gift. I tried it for spa night for T zone and it feels so refreshing and my pores feels like it produces less sebum after and makeup goes on nicely.

I've always had a hard time with peel off Charcoal mask and expected the same from this Space kitten mask but surprisingly THIS MASK IS THE BEST VERSION I'VE EVER TRIED. Easier to apply & peel my skin felt clean of all the impurities & whiteheads. also love the gentle exfoliation and my skin looks less oily and less pores.

This is such a fun, whimsical treat but the ingredients/effects are high end & nonsense. It's a fun one to apply & then peel off the skin. My skin felt cleaner & detoxified! It's a wonderful way to treat yourself. Received complimentary from the brand.

Gifted by brand It has sapphire powder, charcoal and moringa seed oil. Its an exfoliating peel off mask which also detoxify and absorb excess sebum. Apply on T-Zone only. I really enjoyed this mask too as it helps to remove dead skin and some black heads too. It feels so satisfying when i peel it.

I love that this mask does exactly what it claims to do. It removes all of my white heads and I've noticed some brightness in my skin as well. It doesn't hurt like most of the peel off masks on the market. Definitely going to repurchase

This Space Kitten peel off mask made my face so beautifully radiant and super soft. I was worried it would be too drying, but it wasn't at all! It also looks really cool while I have it on my face. It is very shiny and sparkly. I recommend using a silicone applicator to apply it onto your skin.

I recently received this product complimentary from I Dew Care and have been loving it so much lately. It's easy to use and leaves my skin feeling fresh and moisturized. I would highly recommend this product to my friends and family.

This face mask is SO FUN! I normally skip face masks in my routine (I know I shouldn't) but I've always dreaded the clean up process when it wasn't fun to put on. This face mask was so fun & it smelled so good! My face felt so good and so soft. My new staple in my routine!

This is my favorite T-zone peeling mask by far. I have sensitive skin but it doesn't cause redness after using it. It doesn't damage my skin surface but is able to pull out my blackhead, white sebum, and mini hair, esp on my nose area. It's always satisfying to peel it. It smells very nice as well! It's easy-peel, just need to make sure the mask is completely dry before peeling. Otherwise, it's a little bit hard to wash it all off while it's still wet.

I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I really love peel off masks since I believe they're the least messy form of face mask, so I was super excited to try this one. I loved how bright and clean my skin felt after and how easy application was. I struggle with blackheads and I recommend this product!

This was a really lovely charcoal mask. The texture was really nice to apply and I used this when my skin was on the oilier side. Loved that it didn't leave my skin dry after removal and helped with my pores and oil. The peel off was so satisfying but was a little harsh on the skin.

I absolutely love the fun packaging! It is very easy to use and clean after using. The ingredients are nice and perfect for oily t-zones! I found my skin feeling fresh and smooth after one use. I do recommend for oily skin or people with combination skin as the face tends to get oily usually around the nose and forehead.

I love a good charcoal mask and this is such a fun one! I have larger pores on my nose that tend to get clogged easily. I added this to my skincare routine each week and it has really helped get all of the gunk out of them.

This mask is so amazing, also very satisfying. I had never use this product before but as soon. As put it on and peeled it i knew it was my fave, it takes off all of the dead skin and gunk out of your skin. Love it

This is such a fun mask to do either alone or with friends! I love how glittery and cool it looks, which makes it perfect for selfies. It also helps clear out my pores, so cute and effective! A double win!

I have dull and dry skin sometimes and love to exfoliate to make sure my skin looks great again. The Space Kitten Exfoliating Charcoal Peel-Off Mask is great for anyone who is like me and wants to see the impurities coming out of their skin. Makes my face look great!

Such a fun and interactive skin care product. I loved the glitter and galaxy vibes of this mask. Afterwards my skin felt so soft and cleansed. This is a game changer for my stubborn blackheads on my nose. I highly recommend!

Such a cute mask!! This is only for your t-zone, which is the area I have the most blackheads! Love how cute the little scraper is to help apply/remove the mask. Also, such a fun mask since it has glitter inside!
I'm OBSESSED with this mask now! I have always had t-zone issues and this mask is helping to keep my skin clear for the first time in my adult life. I cannot overstate my love of this product enough!

Let me start off by saying this stuff smells amazing. The packaging is super cute. It has sparkles inside. It pulls out the blackheads nice and easy. Leaves my skin feeling nice and soft. Doesn't dry my skin out like most peels.

I like the light scent that I smell with this. I don't feel like it stays there or is there to hide a chemically smell. I definitely feel like the space kitten t-zone clearing did its job the same with the disco kitten and the sugar kitten. I have a lot of retinas in my face and I feel like after I peel these masks off they have done their job. The little pots are perfect for me who doesn't use them often and requires different things in different areas of the face. The space kitten did leave a couple pieces of glitter behind but it was not that big of a deal. These did not hurt when I peeled them off either like some peel offs do.

avis.titre: This is only for the T-zone! Amazing!
avis.texte: It is an amazing product if you know how to use it. Please read the instructions. This is only for the T-zone, where I think we accumulate more and more blackheads. Saying that the product works exactly as it is described and is fantastic. Please don't use it on your whole face or close to your eyes. You will regret it! Then: Welcome to a black-head-free zone.

This is such a fun peel off exfoliating face mask. It has helped my skin look brighter and removed my whiteheads. I love that they use sustainable packaging and clean ingredients. My skin is also looking more smooth. It is sulfate and paraben free.

I did not like this peel off mask at all. It didn't do anything for my skin, except hurt when I had to peel it off. I was really excited to try this mask to help get rid of some blackheads on my nose, but this didn't help at all.

I Dew Care gifted me their Space Kitten Exfoliating Charcoal Peel off Mask and i love it!!! The packaging is to cute and its so satisfying to apply and remove the mask! It doesn't strip away my skin and leave my skin feeling so clean and fresh!

Made my skin tear and it wasn't that great but it did get rid of my blackheads and flaky skin so like it's not the best but it's not the worst it's in the middle smells really good and is black and glittery

I love peel of masks and this one also felt like it helped exfoliate a lot of the dead skin I had in my t zone (especially on my nose). It's easy to use and easy to clean off which is a huge plus for me

Me encanto trabajo súper bien en mi cara la sentí más limpia en mi apariencia de poros y en textura me dejo más suave la piel y con un terminado Matte gracias a su componente de charcoal muy efectiva para problemas de acné

This was sent complimentary by I dew care. This is such a great mask to use when I really want to get rid of some black and white heads on my nose. I tend to get a lot in that area and I always have to use a peeling mask to take them out. I went ahead and applied this mask to my t zone area for starters and left it on there for some time. Once I had to peel off the mask it came off quite well and I did not have a harsh time taking it out thankfully. My skin felt pretty smooth afterwards and a lot of gunk was on the peel showing it worked well. I will definitely use this mask once a week for sure!

I really liked this mask. I only used it in the T zone and it cleared my pores well. My skin is not problematic, I only had small blackheads and the mask cleared everything up! My skin feels soft, clean, fresh and healthy. I don't know how it works, but in addition to making my skin better, it also made my mood better.

I love everything about this mask!! The name is adorable, I love the packaging, and the mask itself is so beautiful and shimmery!!! It's easy to apply (only on the T-zone, avoid sensitive areas) and peels off easiest when it's coated evenly on your skin. This mask has been really helpful getting rid of my blackheads!

Okay. First of all the packagingggggg is amazing! I loved that I saw sparkles in the product it makes it more pleasing to use. I placed this product on my T-zone as instructed and it got off so much gunk from my face. I LOVE this product and will keep using it to take off those pesky black heads. Would recommend :)
